notes.title: New game is here! The official release of "Love Relationship"!
notes.notes:
I've kept you waiting! Under the efforts of perfect testing day and night, ADog's brand new game "Love Relationship" is finally on sale!


The official release includes four languages: Simplified and Traditional Chinese, English and Japanese!


ADog learned from past experience and listened to players' suggestions, this time added a lot of ☆ new patterns ☆ that 

everyone likes


More than 50 luxury dynamic CG, rich and interesting game links, warm and sweet plot, perfect CG appreciation mode and 

achievement system, full dynamic drawing is super - level cute!
Give you an extraordinary experience ❤


What are you hesitating, come on, try it!
